'''Meinar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[third Galactic War]]. He served as a [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic Guard]]<ref name="Secrets" /> in [[3626 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.3}}. Since Meinar appears in The Dark Descent, his fight can be placed in that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as well.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We know how to take down Sith.|Meinar|<ref name="Secrets" />}}
Meinar appears as a boss in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion. Meinar only makes an appearance in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] storyline, given that his role is replaced by [[Ziliss]] in the Republic storyline.<ref name="Secrets" />

In the Imperial storyline, Meinar, along with fellow Republic soldiers [[Corrik]] and [[Osonu]], confronts [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]], [[Darth Krovos]], and [[Darth Rivix]], when they arrive at the [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] [[Jedi Enclave]] to investigate the whereabouts of [[Darth Malgus]]. In the end, Meinar is the only member of his squad left standing while the others were slain. As he is immobilized by Rivix, the Commander confiscates his holocommunicator to call [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Leeha Narezz]]. Narezz refused to betray the details of her mission and signs off, leaving Meiner at Rivix's mercy. The Commander can then order Rivix to execute or spare Meiner or stay silent about his fate. If the light side dialogue is chosen, Rivix will appear to accidentally kill Meinar.<ref name="Secrets" />
